test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_exclusion_search_step_budget (c1 DateTime, c2 UInt8, c3 String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (c1, c2, c3) SETTINGS index_granularity = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_exclusion_search_step_budget SELECT toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 'UTC') + intDiv(number, 4), (number % 4) >= 2, toString(number % 97) FROM numbers(2000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 2000000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 2000000
test.query: SELECT c1, c3 FROM t_exclusion_search_step_budget WHERE c2 LIMIT 0 FORMAT Null
